Echolocation

A creative oracle. Send a question into the dark, read what comes back.

Where are you stuck?

How to read it the figure, moving cards, the joker

A cast draws five cards, one per deck, and reads them from the bottom up. State is where you are: your Stance and the Form the work wants. Movement is what happens next: a Move to make and a Twist that drifts. Proposition is the Constraint you take on. A Strategy sentence sits above the reading as its image.

About one card in four falls moving: it turns into another card from the same deck. You read what is now, then what it is becoming. The five cards make a figure of five lines, still or moving, so there are 32 figures, each named after a notion with its definition.

The Joker is for when you can't even ask. Say where you're stuck and it gives you one thing to do now.

Nothing here is generated. Every card, figure and sentence was written by hand, in one notebook kept between 2004 and 2011.
